name: Junk Removal
summary: Instant photo quotes, crew routing, same-day capacity, and before/after review requests.

automations.title: Instant Quote from Photo Upload
automations.summary: When a customer uploads photos of the items they need removed through the website, this automation automatically generates a preliminary quote range…
steps: When a customer uploads photos of the items they need removed through the website, this automation automatically generates a preliminary quote range based on volume and item type.
Customers get pricing without waiting for a callback, and the crew shows up with a realistic expectation of what the job involves instead of a blind guess.
automations.manualProcess: Done by hand, this depends entirely on a customer service rep remembering to check in, update records, and follow up, with no safety net if something slips. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.

automations.title: Crew Route & Job Sequencing
automations.summary: Based on each day's booked jobs, this automation automatically sequences the route to minimize drive time and dump run trips, and adjusts in real…
steps: Based on each day's booked jobs, this automation automatically sequences the route to minimize drive time and dump run trips, and adjusts in real time if a job runs long or a same-day request comes in nearby.
A day's schedule stays efficient even as it changes throughout the morning instead of falling apart after the first delay.
automations.manualProcess: Handled by hand, a dispatcher spends time each day re-checking the same information across disconnected tools instead of doing higher-value work.

automations.title: Donation vs. Landfill Sorting Report
automations.summary: As items are sorted during removal, this automation automatically logs what's donated versus landfilled, and generates a donation receipt for the…
steps: As items are sorted during removal, this automation automatically logs what's donated versus landfilled, and generates a donation receipt for the customer for tax purposes.
Eco-conscious customers get a differentiator and useful documentation without any extra paperwork burden on the crew doing the physical work.
automations.manualProcess: Manually, a crew leader is stuck doing repetitive follow-ups and data entry that could otherwise run quietly in the background. Over a month, those small manual steps add up to a significant amount of lost time.

automations.title: Same-Day Booking Capacity Alert
automations.summary: This automation monitors the day's remaining truck capacity and automatically closes off same-day booking on the website once trucks are full.
steps: This automation monitors the day's remaining truck capacity and automatically closes off same-day booking on the website once trucks are full.
A crew that's already maxed out for the day never gets overbooked on top of a schedule it can't actually deliver.
automations.manualProcess: Without automation, an operations manager has to notice problems after they've already happened, then scramble to fix them manually one at a time. None of it is difficult, it's just slow, repetitive, and easy to fall behind on.

automations.title: Before/After Photo & Review Request
automations.summary: When a job is marked complete, this automation automatically pairs the before and after photos and sends a review request highlighting the…
steps: When a job is marked complete, this automation automatically pairs the before and after photos and sends a review request highlighting the transformation.
This tends to perform far better than a generic review ask, since the visual contrast does most of the persuading on its own.
automations.manualProcess: Manually, a marketing coordinator is stuck doing repetitive follow-ups and data entry that could otherwise run quietly in the background. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.
